elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The added language warrants only that services will conform in all material respects to an applicable Research Plan or Development Plan. Plan conformity does not require professional and workmanlike performance.

elements.element: The services performance warranty applies for ninety (90) days following performance.
elements.evidence: The clause provides only thirty (30) days following performance.

elements.element: Software conforms to its applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: RevMed warrants that software delivered under the Agreement will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: Non-software deliverables conform to their applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: The added warranty addresses software and services, but does not warrant that other deliverables conform to applicable documentation.

elements.evidence: The software warranty lasts only ninety (90) days following delivery.

elements.evidence: RevMed may repair non-conforming software or re-perform non-conforming services.

elements.evidence: The remedy expressly permits replacement of non-conforming software; reperformance supplies the corresponding service remedy.

elements.evidence: There is no express malicious-code warranty, and Section 13.5 disclaims warranties not expressly stated.

elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The fallback shortens the preferred service-warranty period but does not replace its professional-and-workmanlike standard. The operative language instead requires conformity in all material respects to an applicable plan.

elements.element: The services performance warranty applies for thirty (30) days following performance.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly provides a thirty (30)-day period following performance.

elements.element: Repair or correction, including reperformance where appropriate, is available as a remedy.

elements.evidence: The clause expressly permits replacement of non-conforming software, with reperformance as the service equivalent.

result.reason: The redline supplies the fallback durations, software-to-documentation warranty, and specified remedies, but it does not supply the required professional-and-workmanlike services standard. Conformity to a Research Plan or Development Plan is not equivalent because a service could comply with the plan while still being performed unprofessionally or without workmanlike care. The preferred position also lacks the 12-month software and 90-day services periods, a broader deliverables warranty, legal-compliance warranty, and malicious-code warranty. The addition otherwise leaves unrelated terms intact and operates as an express Article XIII warranty notwithstanding Section 13.5.
